title: Do you clean offices outside normal hours?
body: Yes. Office cleaning can be scheduled early morning, evening, or weekend, depending on crew availability.

title: Can you provide a price during the call?
body: Yes. Atrium can provide a ballpark estimate once service type, area, room count, urgency, and timing are known.

title: Do you need photos?
body: For complex construction cleaning or unusual window jobs, photos may be requested after the call before a final quote is confirmed.

title: Move-out cleaning
body: Kitchen, bathrooms, floors, inside cupboards, fixtures, and handover-ready final cleaning.

title: Office cleaning
body: Workstations, floors, bins, kitchenette, bathrooms, and shared areas.

title: Window cleaning
body: Interior window cleaning, frames, sills, and accessible exterior windows.

title: Construction cleaning
body: Post-renovation dust removal, floor cleaning, debris-ready surface preparation, and final cleaning before handover.

title: Glanz AG pricelist (CHF)
body: Move-out cleaning: base 120, 4.50/m2, room surcharge applies. Office cleaning: base 90, 3.20/m2, recurring plans available. Window cleaning: base 80, 5.00/m2, exterior access may require review. Urgent jobs may apply a 20-25% multiplier.
